description: Get activity feed of platform events. Filter by type: 'market_created' (new markets), 'trade' (executed trades), 'market_resolved' (final outcomes), 'resolution_proposed' (markets entering 24h dispute period). Returns events with timestamps and market-specific payload. `since` is optional — defaults to the last hour. For pagination, pass the returned 'cursor' as 'since' in the next call.

since.description: Return events after this ISO 8601 timestamp (e.g. '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z'). Omit to default to the last hour. For pagination, pass the 'cursor' from the previous response.

types.description: Comma-separated event types: market_created, trade, market_resolved, resolution_proposed. Omit for all types.

name: get_feed
